excerpt.zh: 我们的一位[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]提出了一种拯救[Target.GetName]避免其毁灭的绝妙方案：通过拆解空间站的外部模块和设备并将它们丢入黑洞，这座空间站应该会获得足够的动量以逃逸黑洞的引力束缚。注意，只是说“应该”，这一决策背后的理论从未得到实验的验证。

texts.zh: 我们的一位[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]提出了一种拯救[Target.GetName]避免其毁灭的绝妙方案：通过拆解空间站的外部模块和设备并将它们丢入黑洞，这座空间站应该会获得足够的动量以逃逸黑洞的引力束缚。注意，只是说“应该”，这一决策背后的理论从未得到实验的验证。
texts.en: One of our [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] has devised a clever plan to save [Target.GetName] from its fate: by stripping away any extraneous modules and equipment and hurling them into the black hole, the station should gain enough momentum to escape the black hole's gravitational pull. In this case, 'should' is the operative word: the theory behind this decision has never before been tested.

label.zh: 这是在无谓地浪费资源。

texts.zh: [Target.GetName]上的人员拆除了空间站的模块之后，将它们全部扔向黑洞。空间站和模块分离时产生的动量成功推动了空间站远离黑洞。
texts.en: After stripping the station of its modules, the personnel aboard [Target.GetName] Jettisoned them into the black hole. The momentum caused by the launch has successfully propelled the station away from the singularity.

texts.zh:
[Target.GetName]上的人员拆除了空间站的模块之后，将它们全部扔向黑洞。空间站和模块分离时产生的动量成功推动了空间站远离黑洞。

尽管拆卸抛弃空间站模块的决定为我们争取了更多时间，但是其产生的效果却远远小于我们的预期。这座空间站还是没能达到逃逸速度。
texts.en:
After stripping the station of its modules, the personnel aboard [Target.GetName] Jettisoned them into the black hole. The momentum caused by the launch has successfully propelled the station away from the singularity.

While the decision to jettison the station modules has gained us more time, the results were less effected than expected. The station has not reached escape velocity.
